evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies peer eviction logic during headers sync in `src/net_processing.cpp` and `src/headerssync.h`.
rationale: Prevents nodes on high-latency networks like Tor or I2P from repeatedly evicting active sync peers and losing headers sync progress. As noted in the description, mainnet presync requires roughly 480 round trips; when these take longer than 22 minutes due to latency exceeding ~2.5 seconds, nodes on master treat the outbound sync peer as stalled, evict it, and discard all progress.
